text:
Asha Patel: NexaLabs preview cohort — heads up, 40% of seats still haven't completed the setup checklist. Their enablement session is scheduled next Tue but churn signal flagged in CRM (low product usage). Thinking we need a 2-step outreach + micro-survey before the session. :warning:
Tom Nguyen: Agreed. Can we split outreach: 1) 1:1 quick ping to key users who didn't finish onboarding, 2) 3-question micro-survey to capture friction points. I'll take the 1:1s. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: I can draft the micro-survey and a short email nudge. Suggest questions: 1) What stopped you from finishing setup? 2) What outcome do you want in first week? 3) Any blockers for trial data? Keep it 3 bullet choices + one free text.
Asha Patel: Perfect. Priya, can you drop the survey copy here by EOD today? I'll schedule the enablement with SE and product demo slots. @Tom please ping the users you own.
DevBot: Reminder set — outreach_deadline: 1712443200.
Tom Nguyen: Will ping the 5 accounts now. Quick note: two of them are API-only teams; might need sample prompts and an integration checklist.
Priya Rao: Draft survey below:

---
NexaLabs Preview Quick Check (3 Qs, 30s)
1) What prevented you from finishing onboarding? (a) time (b) missing docs (c) errors/bugs (d) other)
2) Which outcome matters most this week? (a) generate test responses (b) integrate API (c) evaluate cost/perf (d) other)
3) Any blockers we can help with before Tue session? (short text)
---

Asha Patel: Nice. Add a link to the troubleshooting KB and a one-click calendar to book a pre-session 15m if needed.
Tom Nguyen: I'll attach a sample snippet for API teams:
```
# quick curl to test endpoint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
 -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1.2\", \"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Priya Rao: Email nudge template ready, short + CTA to survey + calendar link. Dropping below.

Priya Rao: "Hi — quick 30s check-in: we noticed setup incomplete. Could you fill this 3-question survey [link]? If you'd like help, book a 15m slot [calendar]."
Asha Patel: Can we add an internal metric: respond_rate target 25% within 48h, and show product-usage lift of +10% by next week to avoid renewal flag.
Tom Nguyen: noted. I'll add tags in CRM and set renewal_risk=false if usage uptick before next review.
DevBot: Task created — owner: Tom Nguyen, due: 1712390400.
Maya (Head of CS): Thanks team — keep updates here. If survey response shows consistent doc gaps escalate to Docs owner. :eyes:
Tom Nguyen: pinged users, 2 responses in first hour. Forwarding responses once I have 5.
Asha Patel: Great. We'll reconvene in this thread after the enablement to capture feedback for Optimize suggestions. :calendar:
